scope: Exact CPU upload-change interval optimization, motivated by a bounded native HDR host sample; not native FPS or final isolated G6 acceptance.

profile.scope: Node event-loop sampling only, excluding Chrome/GPU hardware time. No performance gate inferred.

change: Retain the original aligned DWORD forward scan and identical-image fast return.

After finding a difference, scan unchanged trailing bytes with grouped DWORD loads before finding the exact final byte. Sparse guest changes no longer traverse whole trailing image rows one byte at a time.
No cache invalidation, image equality, upload row rounding, guest bytes or host resource lifetime changes.

validation.byteOracle: Every tail length0..131 across16 pairs of independent aligned views, boundary/sparse mutations,4096 deterministic random cases and4MiB native image endpoints agree with independent differing-byte indices.
validation.device: State,texture,graph and full render ordering tests pass.
validation.gpu: Complete real NV40 WebGPU pixel suite passes, including BC partial block-row/cube/mip updates, attachment aliases, GPU blend history, delayed fences and recursive snapshot quiescence.

microbenchmark.limits: Host microbenchmark under concurrent diagnostic load. Unchanged/full-change timing variation is not claimed as an algorithmic or native FPS improvement.
